Young Briggs has shown good form in the Junior events in which he has competed and Jack Frost has taken to running 440 yards hurdles. He might well prove an excellent performer if he will concentrate on improving his style over the obstacles.
In the Youths' Medley Relay, our team of Bruce, Briggs, Lewis and Sexton, ran away from the opposition and put up a really fine show for juniors.

Briggs won the 120 Yards Hurdles in quite good time for a Junior and should do well at this event with more opportunities of match competition.
Briggs of the Surrey Junior Hurdles Championship last season. This was a most regrettable omission and we give our apologies to Briggs, who is now serving in the Army, and is stationed at Larkhill.
